name: Replicate
tagline: Run open-source and commercial AI models via a simple HTTP API
description: Replicate is a cloud platform for running machine learning models through a REST API. Developers can generate images, run language models, transcribe audio, and more by calling model endpoints with inputs; many popular open-source models are available without self-hosting. Authentication uses a personal API token; billing is typically usage-based by model compute.

auth.details: API token via Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_TOKEN header; create tokens in account settings after signup

pricing.free_tier_limits: unknown — free credit often offered on signup; confirm current amount on pricing page
pricing.paid_plans: Pay-as-you-go by model runtime/compute; some models have per-second or per-output pricing

example.request:
curl -s -X POST \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "Prefer: wait" \
  -d '{"input": {"prompt": "a sunset over mountains"}}' \
  https://api.replicate.com/v1/models/black-forest-labs/flux-schnell/predictions

use_cases: generate an image from a text prompt with Flux or SDXL
run an open-source LLM inference call without self-hosting
transcribe audio with Whisper or similar hosted models
upscale or edit an image with a community model
create embeddings or run vision models via hosted endpoints
